title: Knapp and Corbell broke the Fravor Tic Tac story on radio before the New York Times

tellings.quote: is George Knapp and I did break the Commander Fravor story, the Tic Tac story. We did it quietly on the radio twice before the 2017 New York Times article.

plain: A filmmaker named Jeremy Corbell says that he and a Las Vegas journalist named George Knapp were the first to tell the story of a Navy fighter pilot named David Fravor. Fravor's story is about the Tic Tac, a white oval object shaped like the mint. Corbell says the two of them told it "quietly on the radio twice" before the New York Times article of 2017 made it famous. If that is right, the story was public before the newspaper that is usually credited with breaking it.
